subject: English
passage: Biologists long believed that flowering plants first evolved around 140 million years ago, but this view has been ______ by new fossil evidence from eastern Asia, unearthed by Lakshmi Le and Ingrid Johansson, that shows flowering plants were already thriving at least 30 million years earlier.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of scientific views on flowering plant evolution. In this context, "contradicted" means opposed or proven wrong. The text indicates that biologists believed flowering plants first evolved around 140 million years ago, but new fossil evidence from eastern Asia shows they were already thriving at least 30 million years earlier. This context supports the idea that the new evidence contradicted the old view by proving it incorrect.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because describing the view as "misinterpreted," or incorrectly understood, wouldn't make sense in this context. The text indicates that new fossil evidence from eastern Asia has proven the old view wrong, not that biologists have misunderstood what the new evidence shows.
